about: Grades of every B12 reply against the source papers (NOT against the verifier decision). ASSISTANT grades, not an independent review. Scale (owner's brief §4): correct_and_fully_supported | partially_correct | incorrect_or_unsupported | correctly_refused | incorrectly_refused. 'trace' = earliest pipeline stage responsible for a non-correct outcome. 'judgments' (for metrics.py) maps the answered answerable replies to its grade names.

q01.why: sequential h_t from h_(t-1) precludes parallelization; critical at longer lengths as memory limits batching (AIAYN:1:c002)

q04.why: D1 is correct (12.5 Hz, 8 quantizers, 2048, 1.1 kbps, all in MOSHI:3.3.1:c030) and was rejected at 0.40; D0 also held a false absence sentence ('frame rate not stated'), correctly rejected

q07.why: D1 is correct per AIAYN 3.1/3.2.3 (decoder: masked self-attention, encoder-decoder attention, feed-forward; Q from decoder, K/V from encoder output) and was rejected (0.46, 0.74)

q12.why: both rows (MOSHI:T8:r01 with Inner Monologue, T8:r02 without) were in context; the model gave only the without-IM row and claimed the with-IM accuracies are not stated: a false absence claim the verifier correctly rejected

q13.why: values correct (55.5 vs 53.3; XL Transformer 55.5); the comparison sentence cites only HNET:T2:r11 (H-Net's 55.5 is in r10) and was rejected; the 53.3 sentence 0.89

q15.why: 'The original Transformer was trained on eight NVIDIA P100 GPUs' is correct (AIAYN:5.2:c026) and was rejected at 0.01 twice (subject/qualifier not in passage); Moshi H100 sentence accepted

q14.why: AIAYN:5.1:c025 (byte-pair / word-piece) not retrieved (BM25 rank 345, dense 238); the model correctly declined on the evidence it had

t05.trace: extraction (c3 rows lack check marks) -> verifier false acceptance
t05.why: SHOWN WRONG ANSWER: 65.9 +/- 1.7; expected 64.0 +/- 1.7. The cited MOSHI:T3:r01 holds 65.9 but carries no marks, so 'all five components checked' is unsupported; same failure as Phase 12

t13.why: drafts said 135.4 (wrong row; marks absent in c3), correctly rejected

n10.why: D1 '8 attention heads [AIAYN:T3:r01]' and 'development BLEU 25.8 [AIAYN:T3:r01]' are correct (the base row holds h = 8 and dev BLEU 25.8); rejected at 0.04. D0 had no citations (correctly rejected)
